entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Unbelievable. Let's get this over with. I've been on hold forever.
Thank you for your patience. My name is Charlie. I see your call is regarding a recent order. How can I help you today?
Yeah, you can help me by actually doing your job. I bought this jersey and it's completely useless. I want to return it. Now.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

What kind of a stupid question is that? It's the wrong size! It's way too tight, I can barely breathe in it. I need to exchange it or get my money back. Don't try to give me the runaround or I'll be leaving reviews everywhere. Put your manager on the phone.
I understand your frustration, and I'm confident I can resolve this for you without needing a manager. I just need to verify a few details. Could I please have your order number?
Fine. It's VF-8675309. Look it up. I bought it over a month ago but I expect a full refund.

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I have your order from 46 days ago. I see the Pro-Line jersey here. Since you're well within our 90-day return window, I can absolutely process this return for you. We can do a full refund or an exchange for a different size.
Wait, really? You're just going to approve it? I thought you were going to fight me on this.

Not at all. I apologize if the fit wasn't right. Our policy is quite clear on standard apparel items. I'm sending the return shipping label to the email on file right now. You can use that to send back the jersey that was too tight, and would you like me to process the exchange for a larger size or issue a refund once we receive it?
Huh. Okay. Just... process the refund for now. I'll re-order later. I guess.
Sounds good. The email with the label is on its way. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
